name: Miranda
description: Socially inept Miranda always gets into awkward situations; working in her joke shop with best friend Stevie, being hounded by her pushy mother, and especially when she's around her crush Gary.

videos.title: Introducing the Cast
videos.overview: Special features from Series 1 DVD, Miranda introduces us to the cast.

videos.title: Out Takes
videos.overview: Series 1 Special features

videos.title: The Set Tour with Miranda
videos.overview: Series 1 special features, Miranda gives a tour of the set.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes
videos.overview: Series 1 special features

videos.title: Miranda Meets... Clare Balding
videos.overview: Each week, Miranda Hart discusses the inspiration behind the characters with a special guest exclusive on the BBC Red Button. Her first guest is good friend Clare Balding, and they discuss how their time together at school has shaped the character Tilly.

videos.title: Miranda Meets... Frank Skinner
videos.overview: Miranda Hart chats to Frank Skinner about writing the sitcom.

videos.title: Miranda Meets... Sally Phillips And Adrian Scarborough
videos.overview: Miranda Hart chats to Sally Phillips and Adrian Scarborough about acting in front of a live audience.

videos.title: Miranda Meets... Tom Ellis
videos.overview: Miranda Hart interviews Tom Ellis who plays Gary on the show. They talk about Gary being the eye-candy of the show, and what it's like to work on a sitcom full of women.

videos.title: Miranda Meets... Patricia Hodge and Miranda's Mum
videos.overview: Miranda chats to her real-life Mum (Dee Hart-Dyke) and Patricia Hodge, who plays her Mum in the sitcom.

videos.title: Miranda Meets... The Christmas Cast
videos.overview: Miranda sits down and meets with the cast of their Christmas special.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes: Series 3, Episode 3
videos.overview: Miranda and some of the cast discuss and show footage of episode three of series three 'The Dinner Party'

videos.title: Behind the Scenes: Series 3, Episode 4
videos.overview: Miranda and some of the cast discuss and show footage of episode four of series three 'Je Regret Nothing'

videos.title: Behind the Scenes: Series 3, Episode 5
videos.overview: Miranda and some of the cast discuss and show footage of episode five of series three 'Three Little Words'

videos.title: I Do, But to Who?
videos.overview: We find Miranda where we left her, with two proposals - one from Gary and one from Mike. Will she choose one of them or will she run away from the pressures of relationships and the fear of not coping with being a wife?

videos.title: The Final Curtain
videos.overview: It's the final chance for Miranda to try to learn to accept herself and find contentment. Will it be alone, or does she find her one true love? One last chance to hang out with Miranda, Stevie, Penny, Tilly and Gary.

videos.title: My Such Fun Celebration
videos.overview: The cast reunite to look back over a decade of such fun, friendship, romance and everything that made millions of fans connect with this unique and very special sitcom.

videos.title: Date
videos.overview: Miranda gets overexcited by the prospect of her first real date and decides it's time to try to be more girly, but her makeover doesn't go quite to plan.

videos.title: Teacher
videos.overview: Miranda takes French class and Tango lessons so Gary will see her in a sexual light. Things don't quite go to plan.

videos.title: Job
videos.overview: Miranda's mother is ashamed of her joke shop job, so Miranda decides to find a new career.

videos.title: Holiday
videos.overview: Being young, free and single has its advantages, like jetting off to Thailand on holiday for a few days. Miranda however, sets her holiday sights lower.

videos.title: Excuse
videos.overview: An old school insists on throwing Miranda a party to introduce her to a suitable man. Miranda is notoriously bad at coming up with excuses, but when she sees a photo of her intended date he's so bad that the only option left is to lie and come out to her mother.

videos.title: Dog
videos.overview: When a handsome guy leaves his wallet in the shop, Miranda and Stevie argue over who he'd prefer to take to dinner if he had to choose one of them. Meanwhile, Miranda is invited to a regatta and is determined to be able to cope at a tricky social occasion just once.

videos.title: The New Me
videos.overview: In a hilarious attempt to get over Gary, Miranda tries to reinvent herself.

videos.title: Before I Die
videos.overview: Worried about what people may say about her life, Miranda decides to try and do some good.

videos.title: Let's Do It
videos.overview: Miranda doesn't know how to cope when several men turn their affections towards her.

videos.title: A New Low
videos.overview: Miranda competes with Stevie to keep up with a new, young, trendy girl in town.

videos.title: Just Act Normal
videos.overview: Miranda and Penny find it impossible to be normal in a session with a psychiatrist.

videos.title: The Perfect Christmas
videos.overview: It's Christmas and Miranda would like a relaxing and fun time without her parents.

videos.title: It Was Panning
videos.overview: Penny threatens to cancel Miranda's Christmas if she does not sort her life out.

videos.title: What a Surprise
videos.overview: Penny embarrasses Miranda by running for local councillor with Tilly as her wingman.

videos.title: The Dinner Party
videos.overview: Miranda decides to prove to herself and her friends that she can officially be an adult.

videos.title: Je Regret Nothing
videos.overview: Trapped in her flat and being shouted at, Miranda is forced to think about her regrets.

videos.title: Three Little Words
videos.overview: Will Stevie persuade Miranda to declare her true feelings towards Gary?

videos.title: A Brief Encounter
videos.overview: A fed-up Miranda makes a big life decision: she's going travelling.

awards: Nominated for 7 BAFTA 8 wins & 18 nominations total
